item.simulatedcoasters.red_balloon.toolt: Pop! Useful utility item for _moving physics contraptions_
_Lifts_ sublevel slightly off the ground. Orients them _upright_
_Pops_ all nearby balloons, dropping the sublevel

simulatedcoasters.ponder.ponder_track_pl: When connecting two Track Anchorpoints with a Coaster Track...
A wrench can be used to adjust the path of the spline
Tracks will automatically take smooth paths while being placed
Track smoothing can be disabled by holding left alt during placement
Dye can be used to decorate tracks
Right-clicking with an axe removes dye
simulatedcoasters.ponder.ponder_chainlif: With a Chain, select the start and end position to add a chain lift
The shaft on the starting end accepts rotational power and drives the chain
Sneak-right-click anywhere along the chain-lifted span with a Wrench to remove it
simulatedcoasters.ponder.ponder_cart.tex: Coaster carts can be placed on coaster track
With the coaster cart item, right click a placed cart to create a link
Placing a linked cart couples the two carts together
Shears can be used to remove connections
Chains can be used to make new connections
A wrench can be used to adjust the length of a cart connection
Blocks can be placed on coaster carts
